about: MCPs and skills we list in the catalog but don't build: open-source ones (with their repo and licence) and hosted ones from their makers. Always public, never packaged by us: the install plan hands out `install.source`. Admins add one here (or through the admin API, which wins). Skills point at them from their `## First: check the MCPs` table. See apps/mediamake/docs/catalog-releases.md.

items.title: ElevenLabs
items.summary: Sound effects, speech, voices, transcription and audio isolation from ElevenLabs, as files on your computer. The official open-source MCP server, and the key MediaMake's npm run transcribe uses for timed words.

env.name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
env.description: Your ElevenLabs API key. At the link (Developers > API Keys) create one: Restrict Key is on by default, so turn it off or allow Speech to Text, Text to Speech, Sound Effects, Voices and User. Copy it at once (shown only once). MediaMake's npm run transcribe reads it here too.

env.name: ELEVENLABS_MCP_BASE_PATH
env.description: The folder it may read input files from and saves to by default (~/Desktop when unset). Set it to your home folder so it can use files in your projects.

install.notes: Needs an ElevenLabs account (the free tier has 10,000 credits a month) and uv. Every generation spends credits.

items.title: ElevenLabs connector
items.summary: ElevenLabs' hosted connector from Claude's directory: speech, voices and transcription with every word's start and end, plus ElevenAgents voice agents. Signs in with your ElevenLabs account: nothing to install, no key. The alternative to the ElevenLabs MCP where nothing local runs (the Claude web and phone apps).

source.name: elevenlabs-connector
setup: Only when the ElevenLabs MCP can't run here (the Claude web or phone app): sign in with your ElevenLabs account and click Allow. It is ready when Claude has the creative_transcribe_audio tool.

install.notes: Hosted by ElevenLabs: nothing runs on your computer and it can't read your files, so a song on your computer goes in through its file picker widget, and every result (a transcription, a voice, a sound effect) is a flow run to download from. No music. Needs an ElevenLabs account; every generation spends credits. On a computer the ElevenLabs MCP (an API key, files straight on the computer, no widget) comes first.

items.title: fal
items.summary: Image, video and audio models on fal (Nano Banana, upscalers, image-to-video, cutouts), hosted by fal.

install.notes: Needs a fal account with credits: every image or video it makes is paid.

items.title: Blender
items.summary: Build, import and render 3D scenes in Blender from Claude. Open source, through a Blender add-on.

source.name: blender
setup: Install its Blender add-on: `uvx mcp-for-blender install-addon`.

Ask them to open Blender, go to Edit → Preferences → Add-ons and turn on Interface: MCP for Blender. The add-on starts its server when Blender opens (press N in the 3D viewport → MCP for Blender tab → Start MCP Server if it isn't running).

install.notes: Needs Blender 3.0 or newer and uv. Blender has to be open, with the add-on's server running, whenever Claude uses it.

items.title: Gemini
items.summary: Google's Gemini 3 models from Claude: image generation and editing up to 4K (Nano Banana Pro), Veo video, speech with 30 voices, Google Search with citations, deep research, YouTube and document analysis, code execution and a second opinion from Gemini Pro or Flash. Open source, runs on your computer with a Google AI Studio key.

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Your Google Gemini API key from Google AI Studio (Get API key > Create API key; free, takes seconds). The server checks it when it starts, so a wrong key stops it.

env.name: GEMINI_OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: The folder its images, videos and audio are saved to (~/.config/gemini-mcp/output/<folder hash> when unset). With MediaMake's media library set up, point it at the library's inbox (~/Downloads/_INBOX/gemini) so `media ingest` files what it makes.

env.name: GEMINI_TOOL_PRESET
env.description: Which of its 37 tools to load, to keep Claude's context small: minimal, text, image, research, media or full (all 18 tool groups, the default). GEMINI_ENABLED_TOOLS adds tool groups to a preset, e.g. search,image-gen.

install.notes: Needs Node 18 or newer (npx comes with it) and a Google AI Studio API key; the free tier works but is rate-limited (429s: set GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3-flash-preview or move to a paid plan). Images, video, speech and research spend your Google API quota. Also installs the gcli command (npm install -g @rlabs-inc/gemini-mcp) for the same tools from a terminal.
